title: Card Tender Rates on Northgate Tire Center Rotation Charges
content:
# Card tender rates on rotation charges

**Notice.** A Northgate Tire Center rotation charge carries a tender rate read from the **primary tender of the tires' purchase**, as recorded on that purchase in Northgate Purchases & Returns:

| Primary tender of the tires' purchase | Tender rate |
|---|---|
| Northgate Visa | 0.9 |
| Northgate store card | 0.95 |
| any other tender | 1 — the full rate |

## Terms

- Only the primary tender of the purchase on which the tires were bought is read, not the card used for the rotation charge itself.
- The rotation charge is multiplied by the tender rate. The rate acts on the unrounded charge, and the charge is rounded to the cent once, at the end.

## Hypothetical illustration

A rotation charge of $44.00 before this rate becomes $39.60 where the tires were paid with Northgate Visa, $41.80 where they were paid with a Northgate store card, and stays $44.00 for any other tender.
